- scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh:334-343, 392-417, 425 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The 300-second follow-up cooldown is bypassed when the memory ledger is disabled or its read or claim fails.
  WHY: In those cases the helper proceeds to dispatch without enforcing the documented interval, allowing repeated progress ticks to queue back-to-back runs; reviewers rated this MAJOR.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3045-3094 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `record_poll_progress_if_advanced` only persists the first tracking issue encountered when multiple tracking issues advance in one poll tick.
  WHY: Other advanced issues may not receive a fast-follow poll.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1144 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The follow-up step forwards only the first recorded tracking issue, so a cooldown on that issue can suppress a follow-up for another issue that advanced in the same tick.
  WHY: The other project then waits for cron instead of receiving the intended fast-follow; reviewers rated this NIT.

- scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh:346-349, 413-414, 416, 429 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Cooldown skips and dispatch failures do not consistently emit the documented `POLL_FOLLOW_UP` outcome, and disabling memory can produce a misleading memory-failure warning.
  WHY: Searches of the registered log prefix cannot reliably identify these skip or failure outcomes; reviewers rated this NIT.

- google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite:3088 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `poll_progress_tracking_issues` file is not cleared after processing.
  WHY: The reviewer reports that old tracking issue IDs remain and may prevent the same issue from being recorded and receiving a fast-follow later.
